proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you share the DuckDB UI frontend version and the complete UI error/log output (for example the browser developer console or terminal output from `duckdb -ui`), and also run `SELECT version();` in the database and paste that result here? Please confirm you opened the same `test6.db` file in the UI as in the terminal. These details are needed to reproduce and diagnose the “unrecognized type id: 109” error.
proposal.rationale: The report includes the SQL reproducer and DuckDB server version but omits the DuckDB UI/frontend version and the complete UI error/log output (browser console or `duckdb -ui` logs). Those environment/log details are essential to reproduce the UI-specific failure.
